Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Reverts the changes introduced in versions 1.7.1 and 1.7.2 and restores the v1.7.0 implementation. Removes Windows notifications and their settings.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks eight submarine salvage items, NPC sale values, and character-held gil across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, CSV export, and AutoRetainer completion reports through Discord webhooks. Use /ssit to open or /ssit settings to configure notifications.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
Changelog: Aligns daily and monthly history columns and item counts. Makes the status window resizable, collapsible and closable, and adds a reopen button. Removes import controls while preserving existing history.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Logistics Manager
Description: Use /slm to open. Manage submarine supplies, NPC selling, free destinations, stock warnings, and character runs in data center and world priority order. Export low-stock or all-character JSON with owned quantities and client-specific filenames, then merge two receiver clients in Delivery Settings. Deliver editable stacks of 999 via Dropbox IPC after confirming that the matched recipient has stopped for half a second. The supplier stays in place after reaching the handover coordinate until the next world or a pause/resume. Shows remaining required stacks and live inventory shortages. Includes separate supply and sale execution, safe pause/cancel/skip, persistent progress, and home-world return after completion. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh; supplier trading also requires Dropbox.
Punchline: Manage submarine supplies, supplier trading, NPC selling, and multi-character runs.
Changelog: Adds separate low-stock and all-character JSON exports with owned quantities and client-ID filenames. Adds full-character supply runs and separate checked supply/sale execution. Reorganizes settings, controls, and character columns. Displays remaining stacks and live inventory shortages. Suppliers no longer approach recipients or return to the handover coordinate after arrival; resuming or changing worlds restores the coordinate. Confirms recipients are stationary for 0.5 seconds before trading.

Author: unknown
Name: FC Housing Manager
Punchline: Manage housing lotteries across multiple characters and worlds.
Description: Use /fchm to open. Creates housing lottery schedules, automates character switching, plot travel, lottery entry and refunds, records entry numbers from game messages, and sends lottery numbers to Discord. Requires Lifestream; vnavmesh is used when a placard approach is needed. Service account selection follows Lifestream or AutoRetainer registration.
Changelog: Rebuilds the UI and adds world-filtered schedules, batch creation, automatic entry/refund tracking, public Lifestream IPC switching, unclaimed-refund warnings, and read-only history. Migrates legacy character identities as Anima. In-game verification is required.

Author: unknown
Name: Vanity Collection Manager
Punchline: Track unlocked vanity collectibles and discover how to obtain missing items.
Description: Use /vcm to open. Tracks mounts, minions, emotes, Triple Triad cards, chocobo bardings, orchestrion rolls, fashion accessories, and facewear. Includes acquisition sources from FFXIV Collect, tradeability filters, character-specific favorites, and CSV export. Hairstyles are planned and are not included in this initial build.
Changelog: Initial API 15 compatibility build with the existing eight collection categories. Adds /vcm, preserves the legacy command, protects existing acquisition data on update failures, and stores settings in the plugin configuration directory.
